subject: TechCorp Placement Drive - Eligibility Criteria
body:
Dear Students,

We are pleased to announce that TechCorp will be visiting our campus for placements.

Eligibility Criteria:
- Minimum CGPA: 7.5
- Branches: CSE, ISE only
- No active backlogs allowed
- 10th and 12th: Minimum 60% required

Registration Deadline: October 28, 2026 at 5:00 PM

Best regards,
Placement Cell

subject: Correction: TechCorp CGPA Requirement
body:
Dear Students,

Correction to previous email:

The minimum CGPA requirement for TechCorp is 7.0 (not 7.5 as stated earlier).

All other criteria remain the same.

Regards,
Placement Cell

subject: DataSystems Placement - Open to All Branches
body:
Hi everyone,

Thanks,
Dr. Kumar
CSE Coordinator
